thread:
maya: quick thread — sharing a new mock for RBAC "seat map" (compact grid with drag-to-assign). need fast takes on: CTA copy, SSO toggle language, audit log nav placement, and contrast/a11y nits. attaching screenshot in the thread (not here).

jamal: looks promising. quick note — the primary CTA text reads 'Invite' right now, feels a bit generic. can we be more explicit? 'Invite team' or 'Add members to org' maybe.

liam: +1 on being explicit. also curious about the drag behavior: do we allow dropping multiple roles onto a user? how do we surface conflicts? tiny ux question.

maya: good q. plan was multi-select + drag onto a user tile to bulk-assign. conflict rule: show a toast and inline warning on the tile with an inline 'Resolve' link.

olivia: accessibility nit: the drag handle isn't keyboard accessible in the mock. we need a keyboard flow: select role(s) -> press Enter -> focus goes to a 'drop target' modal list. Also aria-live on success/failure.

jamal: for CTA copy experiments, suggested variants: 
```
Invite team
Add members
Grant access
Assign roles
```
my pick: 'Add members' — clear intent and maps to downstream billing language.

maya: noted. sara, any preference from legal/compliance?

sara: 'Add members' is neutral and audit-friendly. avoid 'invite' because some customers auto-invite via SSO and it confuses logs.

liam: SSO toggle label: current label is 'Enable SSO for org' which is long. What about 'SSO (SAML/SCIM)' or two controls: 'SSO (SAML) — Enabled' and a separate 'Provisioning (SCIM) — Enabled'?

olivia: separate controls better. also make the SSO toggle state text visible (not only color). e.g., 'SSO: On' / 'SSO: Off' with accessible focus ring.

maya: agreed. add a small inline help link: 'What changes when SSO is enabled?' that opens the audit-impact doc.

jamal: audit nav: the mock puts audit log under Settings > Security > Audit logs. PM thought maybe Audit should be top-level for org admins. Thoughts?

liam: I vote for top-level, because it's a high-frequency action for enterprise customers troubleshooting access changes. Might be behind a permission gate though.

olivia: UX: if it's top-level we need clear filters primary: actor, action, affected resource, time range. Also keyboard-first filter chips.

maya: implementation constraint: we can't add a new top-level nav item for the next deploy, but we could provide a 'Quick access' pill in the org header that opens audit with a single keystroke ("g a" for go->audit).

jamal: good compromise. also +1 on making the audit page the canonical place for SSO provisioning change logs — tie it to the 'Provisioning' control so toggles link to the exact audit query.

olivia: color contrast check: the role tags use token c-600 on a white tile — preliminary check shows ~3.4:1 which fails AA large text for some sizes. Recommendation: increase to c-700 or add a 1px outline on focus. Also ensure focus visible for keyboard-only users.

maya: can we get exact token suggestions?

design-bot: suggested tokens for contrast tests:
```
role-bg: var(--c-gray-100)
role-text: var(--c-blue-700)
focus-outline: 2px solid var(--c-blue-600)
```

jamal: copy micro-tweak: on the role tile hover menu we show 'Revoke' — for clarity change to 'Remove role' (less harsh).

olivia: agree. 'Revoke' has legal connotations. 'Remove role' is clearer. Also change tooltip for disabled SSO toggle: "SSO disabled — contact admin" -> "SSO disabled for your org — only org owners can enable". more helpful.

maya: action items:
- olivia: keyboard flow doc + aria labels for drag/drop (owner)
- liam: create interaction spec for bulk-assign + conflict states (owner)
- jamal: run copy A/B for CTA 'Add members' vs 'Invite team' in next mock (owner)
- sara: confirm audit retention and whether we can link toggle to query (owner)

sara: I'll confirm retention and write the small blurb to surface when linking.

liam: quick UX question — should the 'seat map' allow role hierarchy visual (indentation) or keep flat?

maya: keep flat for v1 to reduce complexity. we can display parent role in secondary label.

olivia: accessibility follow-up: ensure keyboard shortcut list is discoverable: add '?' quick help in org header.

maya: thanks all — I'll update the mock with 'Add members' CTA, separate SSO/Provisioning toggles, and toggle linking to audit. ping me when specs are ready. :sparkles:
